Review.Findings: Nurik tested the round-1 build the same evening; four new findings (21:01–21:14). (1) main-window min/max STILL dead while the native-chrome Preferences window works — root cause proven against tauri 2.11.2 source: core:window:default grants only read-only queries, so every mutating window call (maximize, minimize, close, setFullscreen, setSize, setAlwaysOnTop) was silently ACL-denied with only a webview-console error; mac never hit it (native traffic lights + mocked shims). Fixed: explicit allow-* permissions in capabilities/default.json; pinned by tests/renderer/tauri-capabilities.test.js so the class of bug cannot silently return. (2) Share button dead on Windows — m032 is an NSSharingServicePicker shim returning Err off-macOS; the button now hides behind the new m048 `share` capability flag (same gate as screenshot/default-handler). (3) «паддинг слева в рабочей области» — by design: centered reading column, width is the editorLineWidth preference (Preferences → Editor); explain to tester, no code change. (4) «кнопка Exit не работает» — menu-bridge/quit chain (hamburger → on_menu_event → mt::menu-invoked → file.quit → mt_app_quit) reviewed and sound; not reproducible without Windows hardware — retest in round 3 with a diagnostic ask (does hamburger → File → New Tab work?). Winget prep (T-105, Amendment #3) landed this round: tools/winget/sync-manifest.sh + reference manifests.

Nurik's manual QA round on the dry-run artifact (15 screenshots in TG, 9 findings). All root-caused and fixed same day: (1) «накладка и мешанина» — the frameless titlebar stacked the share/word-count cluster (absolute left:0) on top of titlebar-nav; hamburger moved into the nav row (button #0), cluster re-homed as .titlebar-aux--custom at right:150px (titleBar v1.5.0; regression pinned in titleBar-windows v1.1.0 + a win32-pinned Playwright probe asserting disjoint nav/aux boxes and zero document overflow). (2) dark theme — window-control icons were fill:#000 (invisible on dark); now currentColor + theme hover vars. (3) boot theme-stomp — ASK_FOR_USER_PREFERENCE hydration dropped keys already mutated during boot (bootDirtyKeys). (4) language switch — setLanguage indexed availableLocales with [locale] (function-indexing bug) and returned an un-awaited promise; now awaits + validates payload. (5) folder tree empty — renderer path shim used POSIX path-browserify on win32; now path-win32 (package.json dep). (6) literal
in the editor — muya htmlTag br branch never applied the ag-hide wrapper; raw text now hides on inactive lines with the real
outside it (htmlTagBr.test.js). (7) «ctrl+zoom зумит внутренний фрейм» + stray h-scrollbar — Ctrl+wheel/= /-/0 now drive the fontSize preference (12–36, debounced persist) instead of --content-zoom; wheel listener is capture-phase so muya stopPropagation can no longer leak WebView2 native browser zoom; body overflow:hidden guards document-level scrollbars.
